tasks.short: Teach pediatric medicine to residents and students

steps.what: Teach pediatric topics and respond to learners' reasoning

tasks.design: The pediatrician teaches, observes reasoning and adjusts explanations in person. Existing teaching material in {LMS} can support the session without replacing the interaction.
tasks.previous_blocker: Understanding a learner's clinical reasoning requires discussion and observation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing learning resources support demonstrations; they do not establish a saving in live teaching.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing when apparently correct answers hide unsafe reasoning.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognises uncertainty and models accountable clinical judgement.
tasks.altitude: Teaching time and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Teaching objectives and each profession's supervision boundaries

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: live clinical teaching requires responsive explanation and supervision; no teaching-time reduction is established here.

assumptions: Boundary is delivery of pediatric teaching, excluding separately scheduled material preparation and assessment administration.
The pediatrician selects existing objectives and teaching cases within s1; learners supply questions during s1. No structured learner-readiness flag is assumed.
Check existing learning-system resources before proposing custom software; existing runtime earns no labour saving.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new application, model or data contract is introduced.
research_questions: Which part of observed teaching time is material preparation rather than interaction?

already_counted.description: Live explanation and observation of learner reasoning

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=100. No changed teaching step or incremental upkeep; central net saving 0%. Scenario retains all live teaching time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide pediatric consultations to other physicians

steps.what: Provide consulting services after assessing another physician's clinical question

tasks.design: The pediatrician reviews the clinical question and provides advice to the referring physician. The clinical record system {OTHER} remains a source of information rather than an autonomous consultant.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice depends on the child's presentation and incomplete clinical context.
tasks.enabler_now: Record access can support consultation but does not replace specialist judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising missing information and deciding when direct assessment is required.
tasks.human_edge: A clinician takes responsibility for advice and communicates its limits.
tasks.altitude: Consultation responsibility remains with the pediatrician.

reach.task: Agree follow-up responsibilities after specialist advice

evidence.claim: Delphyr answers clinicians' questions about a patient record; this capability does not establish autonomous pediatric consultation or a consultation-time saving.
Model knowledge: clinical assessment and advice remain human in this design.

assumptions: Boundary is specialist consultation, excluding separate diagnostic testing and the referring physician's implementation of advice.

The referring physician supplies the clinical question and available records under the existing referral process; the pediatrician checks gaps during s1. No new structured case summary or risk flag is assumed.
OTHER means clinical record system. Check existing record navigation before any custom assistant; native runtime earns no labour saving.
Zero incremental upkeep because the existing consultation process is retained.
unknowns: Access to the referring physician's records
research_questions: How much consultation time is spent finding records versus assessing the clinical question?

already_counted.description: Assessment, clarification and approval of consultation advice

approvals.approved_version: Exact patient, consultation question, record snapshot and advice communicated in s1; a changed recommendation requires renewed pediatrician approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross and net 0%. The scenario preserves assessment, clarification and communication; record-answer capability is not counted as saved clinical time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Plan health programs with clinical priorities and practical delivery constraints
Implement and administer health programs with delivery partners

tasks.design: The pediatrician decides clinical priorities and negotiates delivery with partners, retaining the plan in {DOCS}. Existing {PROJECT} records can track agreed actions while clinical program administration stays human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Program choices depend on local needs, resources and stakeholder agreement.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing planning tools organise commitments but do not make the program decisions.
tasks.still_hard: Adapting standards to delivery capacity without weakening care.
tasks.human_edge: The pediatrician weighs clinical trade-offs and secures cooperation.
tasks.altitude: Program leadership remains unchanged; no routine clerical baseline is inferred from the broad task.

reach.task: Coordinate implementation of a child-health pathway
reach.learn: Service capacity and shared escalation responsibilities

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: planning and administering a health program requires clinical prioritisation and coordination; the broad task does not establish a removable reporting step.

assumptions: Boundary is the pediatrician's program leadership, excluding clinical encounters and partner delivery labour.

The pediatrician examines needs and creates the plan in s1. Delivery partners provide feedback during s2 after implementation begins; no structured readiness score or pre-existing approved plan is assumed.
Use native document and project functions first. Existing tracking runtime is not human effort.
Zero new upkeep because no automation or new reporting obligation is added.
unknowns: Local delivery capacity and available needs evidence
research_questions: Does the actual program role contain repeated clerical reports that can be measured separately?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=45+55=100. Gross and net 0%; scenario retains clinical planning and delivery coordination without inventing automated administration.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Design research to study anatomy or test treatments and procedures
Conduct research observations and interpret findings within the authorised protocol

tasks.design: The pediatrician designs the study in {DOCS} and conducts the scientific work under its authorised protocol. Existing research data systems {OTHER} retain observations without changing responsibility for study conduct or interpretation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scientific validity depends on study design, trustworthy observations and expert interpretation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing research tools support data handling but no particular repetitive calculation or report is specified here.
tasks.still_hard: Separating treatment effects from bias and recognising limits of the evidence.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher chooses defensible methods and interprets uncertain findings.
tasks.altitude: Scientific responsibility and research effort remain unchanged.

reach.task: Agree collection and interpretation limits for study measurements
reach.learn: Measurement validity and sample handling constraints

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: the broad research task does not establish a specific automatable scientific judgement or clerical baseline.

assumptions: Boundary is pediatrician study design, conduct and interpretation, excluding separate regulatory review, laboratory processing and publication administration.

The pediatrician creates the protocol in s1. The responsible study governance body supplies required authorisations after s1 and before study activity in s2 under the existing process; that unchanged outside labour earns no saving.
The pediatrician and research team produce observations during s2, before interpreting them; no clean analysis dataset is assumed free.
OTHER means research data system. Check native data functions first; existing runtime earns no labour saving.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new research automation is introduced.
unknowns: Available data quality and analysis support
research_questions: Which recurring data-handling activity has a measured manual baseline separate from scientific work?

already_counted.description: Study design, observations and scientific interpretation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+65=100. Gross and net saving 0%; scenario retains scientific work and does not apply documentation-study savings to research conduct.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The pediatrician retains teaching, consultation, program leadership and scientific judgement.
reach: Coordinate multidisciplinary teaching and follow-up responsibilities.
role.ambitious_version: Stronger teaching and collaborative program delivery, without an unmeasured capacity claim.
